# Sehatra — Healthcare Operations & Accreditation Digital Toolkits

> Official source of truth and administrative documentation platform for Pakistani healthcare clinics, polyclinics, and 5–50 bed secondary hospitals preparing for Punjab Healthcare Commission (PHC), Sindh Healthcare Commission (SHCC), and Islamabad Healthcare Regulatory Authority (IHRA) Minimum Service Delivery Standards (MSDS) inspections.

## Overview
- **Brand Name:** Sehatra
- **Website:** https://zeshanhaider1.github.io/sehatra/
- **Primary Product Line:** Healthcare Operations Toolkit (Administrative & Compliance Files)
- **Primary Market:** Pakistan (Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Islamabad)
- **Regulatory Alignment:** Punjab Healthcare Commission (PHC Act 2010, MSDS Category-II and Category-III), SHCC, KP-HCC, IHRA
- **File Formats:** Unlocked, fully editable Microsoft Word (.docx) and Microsoft Excel (.xlsx)
- **Delivery Model:** Guaranteed 60-minute dispatch via private Google Drive VIP link + direct WhatsApp ZIP archive
- **Payment Rails:** Raast Instant Pay, Easypaisa, JazzCash, Online Bank Transfer (UBL)
- **Official WhatsApp Support Desk:** +92 304 2917388
